items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: But they sent for me to join this show along the way to Canada... Bernard Miller I think was the producer. He was Olivette's father

ctx.x: I think that must have been about 1935, because my father came and got me and made me...took me back home. That was before I got out here.

And another show...let's see, I went back... How did I get back to Cleveland? With some other road band. I can't even think of the name of it. And somehow I got to Columbus, Ohio, which is where Sweets was playing, incidentally. This other show, Brownskin Models... I think there were two segments of this show. But anyhow, the Brownskin Models, Blanche Thompson... Bernard Miller I think was the producer. He was Olivette's father; he's long since gone. But they sent for me to join this show along the way to Canada,…
